title: check warns when a goal clause names a landing's outcome and its mapped check never drives a landing
goal: backlog.py check (or precheck) warns when a committed item's goal clause says a landing or push fails or refuses and the check its clauses mapping names neither runs land, done --commit nor sync on a fixture, so a clause such as BG-viwywxml's 'the landing that closes an entry fails a check' is not credited by a check that only calls check_problems (SP-honlhzdc review, BG-2mdkl622)

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,argparse,os
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_land
def one(**v):
    return {'BG-bbbbbbbb': v}
def run(sg,items,files=()):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
    for p,t in files:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)),exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'add','-A'],check=True)
    bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa']=dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',title='s',status='planned',goal=sg)
    for k,v in items.items():
        it=dict(id=k,sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',status='draft',title='t',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)'])])
        it.update(v)
        bl.items[k]=it
    o=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o):
        bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,argparse.Namespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
    return [l for l in o.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
goal='The landing that closes an entry fails a check.'
def mk(argv):
    return dict(kind='story',goal=goal,touches=['_tools/bl_land.py'],clauses=[dict(clause=goal,check=0)],checks=[dict(run=argv)])
bad=run('g',{'BG-bbbbbbbb':mk(['python3','-c','import sys; print("check_problems"); sys.exit(1)'])})
good=run('g',{'BG-bbbbbbbb':mk(['python3','_tools/backlog.py','land','BG-bbbbbbbb'])})
sys.exit(0 if any('BG-bbbbbbbb' in l for l in bad) and not any('BG-bbbbbbbb' in l for l in good) else 1)
